description: Ask GoMain's brokerage to acquire a domain someone else owns. GoMain researches it, approaches the owner without naming the buyer, negotiates within the budget (which the owner never sees), and closes through Escrow.com. Confirm the buyer's email and budget with the user before calling. Returns a deal id and status key for broker_status.

email.description: The buyer's email, for progress reports and the escrow invitation

max_budget.description: The most the buyer will pay, in US dollars

notes.description: Anything the broker should know, like a deadline

name: request_acquisition
title: Have GoMain buy a taken domain
